meta.name: redesign-existing-projects
meta.description: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将现有网站和应用的视觉设计提升至高端品质
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有设计粗糙的网站或应用，想在不破坏功能的前提下提升视觉品质
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade existing websites and apps to premium visual quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a rough-looking site or app and want to elevate its design without breaking functionality

howto.what: 给它一个现有项目，Claude 会先读代码、找出通用的 AI 设计套路和薄弱细节，再在原有技术栈上做定向升级，产出更精致的界面，且不重写、不破坏原有功能。
howto.when: 当你要改造已有网站或应用的外观，或想摆脱一眼就看得出的 AI 味界面时触发；对任意 CSS 框架或原生 CSS 都适用。

say.text: 帮我审查这个项目的设计，列出所有通用的 AI 设计痕迹。
say.note: 它会扫描代码并输出问题清单。

say.text: 按你的标准升级这个页面的字体、配色和阴影，别动功能。
say.note: 在原技术栈上做定向修改。

say.text: 把这些卡片改成不对称网格，别再三列等宽。
say.note: 布局类升级可以直接点名。

howto.what_en: Point it at an existing project: Claude reads the code, lists generic AI design patterns and weak spots, then applies targeted upgrades on your current stack without rewriting or breaking functionality.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to restyle an existing website or app, or remove a generic AI look from the UI. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.

say_en.text: Audit this project's design and list every generic AI pattern you find.
say_en.note: It scans the codebase and reports the issues.

say_en.text: Upgrade the fonts, colors and shadows on this page, keep the functionality.
say_en.note: Targeted fixes on your existing stack.

say_en.text: Make these card columns less symmetrical with an asymmetric grid.
say_en.note: You can name a layout upgrade directly.
